    Exclusive The Young and the Restless Spoilers Friday, September 25: Victor’s Devious Scheme, Jack’s Downfall, Nick’s Dire Dilemma

    Victor launches another scheme against the Abbotts as Nick wrestles with a difficult decision and Jack vows to protect his family from danger.

    By Dorathy GassOn Sep 23, 2026

    (This article contains spoilers for the upcoming episode of The Young and the Restless, airing Thursday, September 24 in Canada and Friday, September 25 in the United States) 

    The Young and the Restless spoilers for Friday, September 25, suggest Victor Newman (Eric Braeden) will up to no good (as per the usual), while Nick Newman (Joshua Morrow) faces a new obstacle.

    Plus, Jack Abbott (Peter Bergman) makes a promise. Find out more about Friday’s show below.

    Key Takeaways

    • Victor plots against Jack and Jabot
    • Nick faces a difficult new obstacle
    • Sharon helps Nick with a major decision
    • Jack makes Diane a promise
    • Patty remains a dangerous wildcard

    Victor Newman Plays Dirty

    The Young and the Restless spoilers for Friday, September 25, indicate that Victor will do his best to set Nikki Newman (Melody Thomas Scott) for success; however, it looks like he’ll do some to ensure Jack’s failure.

    Nikki is heading up Vibrante, Jabot’s newest rival, so it sounds like he’s got a devious scheme up his sleeve to bring down Jack’s company. What’s The Moustache up to now?

    Jack Abbott’s Promise

    Speaking of Jack, he’ll make a promise to Diane Abbott (Susan Walters). This is likely about Patty Williams (Stacy Haiduk) being out on the loose.

    No one can blame Diane for being nervous about Patty striking against the Abbotts, considering the last incident that involved the woman.

    Still, can Jack guarantee to keep his family safe, as Patty is such a wildcard?

    Nick Newman’s New Obstacle

    Lastly, The Young and the Restless spoilers for September 25 imply that Sharon Newman (Sharon Case) will help Nick navigate through a hard decision.

    Is this about his addiction recovery or work? Then again, maybe this is about Matt Clark (Roger Howarth)? The man still hasn’t left Genoa City despite declaring he would for the millionth time, so will Nick want to take matters into his own hands?

    Doing so, could jeopardize the progress he’s made with his painkillers’ addiction.

    Nick needs to focus on Nick, so Sharon may remind him that his kids and family need him to stay as far away from Matt as possible!

    Are you excited about Friday’s show? Join the conversation below! Watch Y&R daily to catch all the drama in Genoa City and visit this site often for the best Young and the Restless news, spoilers, and updates.
